rubrics.justification: Describes a good-quality blastocyst with visible cavity, compact ICM, intact zona, and generally favorable TE; appropriately notes uncertainty from a single static image. Minor issue is some ambiguity around expansion stage versus the provided lab grade.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve markers, oocyte yield, sperm parameters, endometrial thickness, first-cycle status, and untested embryo status into prognosis and transfer planning.

Reasoning is logical and structured, with conclusions generally supported by morphology and clinical factors. Small inconsistency arises from questioning the 2AA/full blastocyst labeling while still using it in prognosis.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice: single embryo transfer at age 34 with a good Day-5 blastocyst, standard luteal support, avoidance of alcohol, and cautious use of PGT-A. Minor deviation is leaning on implantation/live birth percentages without explicit clinic-specific caveats beyond general uncertainty.

Provides clear next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, lifestyle optimization, review points after failure, and when to consider further uterine/metabolic workup or PGT-A.
